newer_changes_search: Web search for 2025-2026 PMFBY changes: the cited PIB factsheet is dated 29 Aug 2026 (current; 25 States/UTs in Kharif 2026, premium caps 2% / 1.5% / 5% unchanged). Revised modalities announced Nov 2025 for Kharif 2026 (wild-animal add-on cover, paddy inundation restored, 72-hour loss reporting) do not affect the eligibility rule or premium caps. A Kharif 2026 interim advisory (state copy) says the 2026-2030 tender cycle was under appraisal with an interim extension to 30.09.2026, so Rabi 2026-27 terms could change. No discontinuation or renaming found.

findings.note: The portal snapshot is only the page title (82 bytes; JavaScript app), so nothing cited to it can be checked. The documents aadhaar and bank_account cite this source, and the enrolment channels in how_to_apply (bank, CSC, insurance company, website) are not in any snapshot.
findings.suggestion: Add the PMFBY Operational Guidelines 2023 (pmfby.gov.in, guideline) as a source for documents and enrolment channels; it would also allow the farmer rule to be 'confirmed'.

findings.note: occupation is a single-choice member field; a household where another member farms, or a sharecropper who answers 'daily_wage', gets NOT_ELIGIBLE. Acceptable approximation, guidance confidence is right for a govt_statement.
findings.suggestion: Optionally mention in the rule text that sharecroppers should choose 'farmer'.

findings.note: The 2026-2030 implementation cycle was still under appraisal per the Kharif 2026 advisory.
findings.suggestion: Re-check before Rabi 2026-27 enrolment; 120 days is acceptable.
